safety_tips.tip: Watch belongings in crowded tourist zones such as the Duomo, Uffizi and Colosseum area
Keep bags zipped and worn in front in busy areas
Be cautious of distraction scams near attractions
Avoid unofficial taxis near train stations
Stay alert in transport hubs, especially Roma Termini
Keep bags in front and stay alert at Milano Centrale, Roma Termini and Venezia Santa Lucia
Keep luggage in sight and never leave bags unattended at Milano Centrale, Roma Termini and Venezia Santa Lucia
Keep bags in front in crowded areas and avoid loose pockets for phones and wallets
Be extra mindful of belongings around busy tourist attractions
Stay alert in crowded tourist spots such as the Eiffel Tower, Colosseum, train stations and Lucerne's bridge
Keep valuables in a money belt or crossbody bag and avoid backpacks in metros
Use registered taxis or rideshares and confirm the fare before entering
Withdraw cash only from ATMs inside banks or shopping centers
Avoid poorly lit alleys at night, especially around train stations
Keep photocopies of passport and visa separately from the originals
Pickpockets operate around Termini station and buses #64 and #40
